prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Controlling Your Desktop Pet", "Try moving, minimizing, and interacting with your pet right on your screen before completing setup.", "1. Drag pet across screen | 2. Click for context menu | 3. Double click to hide", "I'm ready!"]
1: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Keep your pet happy with quick hotkeys and desktop gestures.", "Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P to Summon/Hide", "Right-click Pet for Feeding & Voice Chat"]
2: ["Customize Your Pet's Personality", "Select temperament and voice traits to make your desktop pet truly unique.", "Playful | Calm | Energetic | Studio Companion", "Save Traits"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace", "Initializing graphics engine... | Loading pet animation sprites... | Checking desktop display permissions..."]
5: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously adopted pets.", "Account Pet Protection: Existing pets automatically sync."]
6: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Adventure", "Select how you want to interact with your pet daily.", "Choose between a relaxed ambient desktop pet or an active focus companion."]
7: ["We will play a chime as soon as your pet is active on screen."]
8: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Choose Instant Pick to get started in seconds, or Custom Creator for a personalized pet.", "Instant Pick (Ready in 5s) | Custom Creator (Upload photos)"]
9: ["Unlocked: Free Starter Toy & Snack Pack!", "Finish setup to claim your bonus desktop pet starter kit."]

verdicts.problem: Asks user to upload photos, requesting personal information.
Mentions free extras and bonus items.
